title: Fixed Open Pocket and Pierced Web Baseball Glove
description: One newly authored complete static baseball-style receiving glove appearance. An asymmetric thick open concave palm rises into a broad rounded finger side and opposed shorter thumb lobe, with a complete genuinely pierced grid web joining their upper edges. A full separate open annular wrist cuff and its binding join the lower palm root. The palm has an actual recessed receiving bowl rather than a black decal; the thin web has through apertures rather than alpha texture. This is not the old closed padded boxing fist or five-finger plate gauntlet recoloured: no geometry is reused. Fixed display lying on a finite back patch, not an actual hand or wearable finger-channel model. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and horizontal envelope-centred ground origin. One glove, no ball or partner glove, zero scenes. No catch performance, articulated fit, grip, padding response, fastening, protective capability, sport compliance, manufacture or safe-use claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
